description:
Filed s520 by s519a while probing ruling 3 (found, not caused: identical on an fca3593b extraction).  Pl::Parser's leading-local machinery reads only the FIRST subscript of a chain:
  our %rm = (R => { a => 1, c => 3 });
  { local $rm{R}{c} = 9; print "$rm{R}{c}\n"; }    # perl 9, PCL "" (it localizes $rm{R} itself and sets it to 9)
  print "$rm{R}{c}\n";                              # perl 3, PCL 3
  my $x = { a => 1, b => 2, c => 3 }; my @hc = qw(a b);
  { local $x->@{@hc}; print join(",", map { $_ // "u" } @$x{qw(a b c)}), "\n"; }   # perl u,u,3, PCL u,u,u
`local $rm{R}->{c} = 9` is the same miss.  SILENT WRONG.  The fix belongs in _process_local_declaration's subscript arms (Symbol + Subscript, Symbol + -> + Subscript, and the s520 Cast + Subscript arm): the container is everything up to the LAST subscript, evaluated as an ordinary expression (the `(unbox BASE)` the arrow arm uses), and the postfix `->@{...}` / `->@[...]` spellings are a slice of the referent (p-local-hash-slice / p-local-array-slice).
subject: `local $h{a}{b} = V` and `local $r->@{...}` localize the wrong slot (pre-existing on fca3593b): a multi-level subscript chain and the postfix slice
